items.title: Yala — personal finance app for iPhone
body: This video shows every use of the Gmail scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly in Yala, end to end, and why a narrower scope is not enough.
• Scopes requested by the app (same as configured in Google Cloud Console): openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile, gmail.readonly.
• Recorded with the development build "Yala Dev" on the iOS Simulator. The OAuth app's publishing status remains "In production".
(The app UI is shown in English; the Gmail connection sheet is in Spanish and is translated on screen.)

items.title: Home > Inbox
body: • The Inbox holds draft expenses that the user reviews before saving.
• The envelope button at the top right is "Connect Gmail".

items.title: "Bank email" sheet, before any Google screen
body: Translation of the sheet:
• "Connect your Gmail and your bank's alerts arrive in the Inbox on their own."
• Yala only searches your bank's alert emails (for now, BCP).
• Each alert becomes a draft: you review it and save it.
• The email is read on this iPhone. It is not sent to any server or to any AI.
• Yala does not read the rest of your email, does not write or delete anything, and does not sell or share your data.
• You can remove the permission at any time, here or in your Google Account.

items.title: "Continue with Google"
body: • iOS asks to use accounts.google.com to sign in > Continue.
• Google's sign-in page opens in English.
(The account email, password and 2-step verification are cut from the video for privacy.)

items.title: Expected while verification is pending
body: • "Google hasn't verified this app" > Advanced > Go to Yala (unsafe).

items.title: Yala requests Gmail access
body: • App name: Yala.
• New access requested: "View your email messages and settings" — this is https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly.
• "Yala already has some access": the sign-in scopes granted earlier.

items.title: Every requested scope, expanded
body: gmail.readonly > View your email messages · Search your email messages · View your settings.
"3 services" Yala already has:
• See your personal info… > userinfo.profile
• See your primary Google Account email address > userinfo.email
• Associate you with your personal info on Google > openid
No other scope is requested. The user taps Continue.

items.step: STEP 6 · HOW THE SCOPE IS USED (1/2)
items.title: Search: only the bank's alert emails
body: • Gmail API users.messages.list with q = "(from:<bank alert sender> …) newer_than:180d", maxResults = 5.
• The query only matches known bank alert senders (e.g. notificaciones@notificacionesbcp.com.pe). No other email is listed or opened.
• Result: "5 new drafts in the Inbox", for the connected account.

items.step: STEP 6 · HOW THE SCOPE IS USED (2/2)
items.title: Read the body and create a draft
body: • For each match, users.messages.get (format=full).
• The MESSAGE BODY is parsed on the device: amount, currency, merchant and date. These fields only exist in the body of the bank alert.
• Each alert becomes a draft marked "Email" in the Inbox.

items.step: STEP 7 · THE USER REVIEWS AND SAVES
items.title: Draft > expense
body: • The user opens the draft (Disney Plus, $20.78, yesterday), picks a category and saves it.
• Nothing is saved without the user's review.

items.step: WHY A NARROWER SCOPE IS NOT ENOUGH
items.title: gmail.readonly is the narrowest scope that can read the alert's body
body: • gmail.metadata — headers and labels only. The amount, merchant and date are in the body, so the feature cannot work.
• gmail.labels, gmail.send, gmail.compose, gmail.insert — cannot read messages.
• gmail.addons.current.message.readonly — only inside a Gmail add-on, for the message the user has open in Gmail. Yala is a native iOS app that imports alerts without the user opening each email.
• Gmail has no scope limited to one sender. Yala limits itself: the search query only matches bank alert senders, at most 5 recent messages, read-only.
• Yala never sends, modifies or deletes email.

items.title: The user can remove access from the app
body: • The sheet shows "Connected as …" and "Remove Gmail permission".
• Tapping it revokes the token with Google (GIDSignIn.disconnect). "Connected as …" disappears.

items.title: Limited use of Gmail data
body: • Gmail data is read and processed on the user's device only. It is not sent to Yala's servers or to any AI service.
• Not sold, not shared, not used for advertising, not used to train AI models. Privacy policy: https://yala-app.pe/privacy
OAuth clients in project yala-502622:
• "Yala iOS (dev)" and "Yala iOS (prod)": the same iOS app (development and App Store builds). Both show this same consent screen and flow; this recording uses the dev client.
• "Yala Web (MCP)": web sign-in for Yala's AI-assistant connector. It requests only "email profile" and never requests any Gmail scope.
Thank you for reviewing.
